newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SAIL down five pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India's SAIL down five pct on results.

text.p: Shares of Steel Authority of India (SAIL) fell one rupee, or 5.3 percent, to 17.75 on the Bombay Stock Exchange on Thursday after the firm announced a steep fall in net profit, traders said.
They said SAIL shares were trading 1.10 rupees lower at 17.75 on the National bourse.
SAIL said on Wednesday its net profit plummetted to 5.27 billion rupees in 1996/97, from 13.19 billion in the previous year.
SAIL shares fell more than seven percent on the Bombay bourse on Wednesday ahead of the firm's results.
